findings: The static initializer builds FIVE OptionTypeInfo maps, not one: CompressionOptions (9), CompactionOptionsFIFO (4), CompactionOptionsUniversal (8), MutableCFOptions (62), ImmutableCFOptions (31) = 114 entries. The Mutable/Immutable split is proven by the consumer 0x6086e00, which serializes map 0x6506b20 under the literal 'MutableCFOptions' and map 0x6506ae0 under 'ImmutableCFOptions'.

This resolves the first open unknown of #4239: PrepopulateBlobCache's map home is MutableCFOptions (offset 0x144, type 18 enum, verification 0, flags 0x100); it is built by the enum helper 0x6083c90, which hardcodes type 18 at value+0xa8.

Three names address the same TableFactory field at ImmutableCFOptions+0x78: table_factory (type 22, verification 1, flags 0xc402), block_based_table_factory and plain_table_factory (type 22, verification 5, flags 0x402). Two names address the MemTableFactory field at ImmutableCFOptions+0x68: memtable_factory (verification 1) and memtable (verification 5), both type 22, flags 0x400. The binary literally builds separate entries at the same offset with different verification/flags, so the names are aliases of one field with different parse/verify behaviour.

19 entries carry verification 4: the apply path accepts and ignores them and never dereferences their offset, so all of them record offset 0. They are: ttl, bottommost_temperature, expanded_compaction_factor, filter_deletes, hard_rate_limit, max_grandparent_overlap_factor, memtable_prefix_bloom_bits, memtable_prefix_bloom_huge_page_tlb_size, memtable_prefix_bloom_probes, min_partial_merge_operands, snap_refresh_nanos, soft_rate_limit, source_compaction_factor, verify_checksums_in_compaction, compaction_measure_io_stats, max_mem_compaction_level, purge_redundant_kvs_while_flush, rate_limit_delay_max_milliseconds, table_properties_collectors.

Each map's first entry sits at its struct's offset 0 with verification 0 (a genuine first field, not an ignored entry): window_bits (CompressionOptions), max_table_files_size (CompactionOptionsFIFO), size_ratio (CompactionOptionsUniversal), write_buffer_size (MutableCFOptions), compaction_style (ImmutableCFOptions).

CompactionOptionsFIFO's ttl entry is verification 4 / offset 0 (accepted-and-ignored, like #4237's offset-0 entries); the binary field order is max_table_files_size @0, allow_compaction @8, age_for_warm @16.

Nested entries route through sub-maps: compaction_options_fifo -> CompactionOptionsFIFO, compaction_options_universal -> CompactionOptionsUniversal, compression_opts and bottommost_compression_opts -> CompressionOptions. The last two are built by the nested-template builder 0x607f1b0, which delegates to the type-19 builder 0x5e32c70, and installed by the pair-move helper 0x60842a0.

The two vector entries (max_bytes_for_level_multiplier_additional @0xc0 and compression_per_level @0x1c8) are built by the vector helpers 0x6083570 / 0x6083d80, which hardcode type 20 at value+0xa8 and take an element tag 0x3a in r9d.

The DBOptions section string (0x6506c80) is NOT built by this initializer: it belongs to the sibling DBOptions initializer analysed in #4237. This initializer builds seven section strings (Version, CFOptions, TableOptions/, Unknown, compression_opts, bottommost_compression_opts, ColumnFamilyOptions).
